name: Stranger Still
source:
ACCEPT

Eat the meat. Become the prey. But yet…
you may still live

or

DECLINE

Retain yourself. Retain your humanity.
But become someone else's meal


These are the only options he's given you, but surely you're clever enough to find another way out, right?

Stranger Still is a supernatural gothic-horror ending collection Visual Novel about a conversation with a stranger over a suspicious dinner.

Ask the right questions in the right order to figure out information that might save your life, or might just end it in an unsuspecting way.

[From [url=https://k-ramstack.itch.io/stranger-still]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接受

吃肉。成为猎物。但还……
你可能还活着

或

拒绝

保留自己。保留你的人性。
却成了别人的饭菜


这是他给你的唯一选择，但你肯定足够聪明，能够找到其他出路，对吧？

《Stranger Still》是一部超自然的哥特式恐怖结局视觉小说合集，讲述了在一次可疑的晚餐上与陌生人的对话。

以正确的顺序提出正确的问题，找出可能挽救你生命的信息，或者可能以毫无戒心的方式结束你的生命。

[来自[url=https://k-ramstack.itch.io/stranger-still]itch.io[/url]]
